ModMetadata.Name: ic10go exporter
ModMetadata.Author: ic10go
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]ic10go exporter[/h1]
Dumps the data the external ic10go compiler cannot read offline: every prefab's name, hash and title, which logic types each device accepts for reading and writing, and every inventory slot's class and per-slot read/write logic types.
It scans once on load, writes two JSON files under Documents\My Games\Stationeers\ic10go\, and does nothing else. There are no patches and no runtime behaviour, so it is safe to leave installed.
Run it once after each Stationeers update, then feed the files to `go run ./tools/import-devices` in the ic10go repository.
